messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout starting now: model xlarge-v2.1 -> EU then APAC then US. Canary EU 3% (10m hold). Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Auto rollback thresholds enabled.
ash: Quick check — EU warm pool / reserved GPUs? do we have cushion for warmup? :thinking:
mira: EU reserved 12 GPUs, warm_pool=4(spot-spare), spare_nimble=2. Expected steady rps 450, planned cushion ~20%.
jorge: Canary config? what metrics trigger auto rollback? I'm thinking error_rate>1% OR p95>350ms sustained 3m.
sam: Agreed. Rollback triggers: error_rate >= 1% over 3m OR p95 > 350ms over 3m OR 5xx spike > 0.5%. Manual override: ops can pause and pin.
deploy-bot: Commands for ops:
```
redwood pin-version --region eu --version v2.1 --until 2026-03-22T02:00Z
redwood set-canary --region eu --pct 3 --hold 600
redwood set-rollback-policy --region eu --err-rate 0.01 --p95-ms 350 --window 180
```
mira: Release notes snippet for this rollout:
- model xlarge-v2.1: improved context handling and 8% cost perf win
- known limitation: rare tokenization mismatch on very long prompts (fallback to v2.0)
- no schema changes, client-side unchanged
ash: timeline? when do we do go/no-go checks?
sam: Start EU canary now. Check at +10m for smoke, +30m for steady-state. If smoke passes, start APAC canary (+30m). Hold before US until APAC steady.
jorge: Running smoke now -> health checks: /health ok, rerank test ok. quick perf: p50 78ms p95 210ms errors 0.09%
ash: :thumbsup: EU smoke looks good to me. Approve APAC staging.
mira: Scheduling APAC kickoff +31m. APAC warm pool prewarmed.
deploy-bot: APAC canary set to 5% (regional traffic patterns). Pin fallback to v2.0 for APAC pre-baked.
ash: If APAC shows >0.5% error, we rollback APAC and pause US, correct?
sam: Correct. Escalation path: page on-call, pin region, block US rollout. Ops will run manual revert if auto-rollback misfires.
jorge: Noted. I'll run extended smoke at +10m into APAC.
mira: Also posting the short release note to #release-notes after APAC steady. I'll attach changelog.
nash: One last ask — can we add a rate limiter tweak for US paths before US rollout? small qps cap to avoid cold starts.
sam: Ops will deploy 10% ingress throttling rule for US during initial ramp.
deploy-bot: EU canary completed 30m steady-state, no triggers. APAC canary in-flight. Will post updates.
jorge: APAC smoke (10m): p50 95ms p95 330ms errors 0.4% -- within thresholds. No rollback.
ash: Great. Proceed US after 45m cool window. I'll update the release ticket with timings.
mira: Copy. Publishing release notes and toggles.
sam: Remember: if US p95 climbs >400ms during ramp, pause and revert US pins. Keep watch.
deploy-bot: Final: rollout plan executed as scheduled. Ops on standby. :rocket:
